card.name: Scattered list and name positions
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words such as 'the' before an institute name, 'My' in a list, or inside drug names like phenobarbital, nifedipine and fluticasone.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of long drug names in interaction lists.

modes.label: Start of a named item
modes.description: A small word starting a named place or list entry.

card.writes: Weakly promotes field names like astronomy, fisheries, aviation and ophthalmology, but the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on a mix of unrelated spots, mostly in lists and inside drug names, with no single clear trigger.
